description: This file contains selector functions for managing roles, permissions, and group memberships within the Mattermost Redux state, including functions to check permissions at team, group, and channel levels.

methods.name: getMySystemPermissions
methods.description: Selector returning the set of system permissions for the current user.

methods.name: getMySystemRoles
methods.description: Selector returning the set of system roles for the current user.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Selector returning all roles as a record.

methods.name: haveISystemPermission
methods.description: Function to check if the user has a specific system permission.

methods.name: getGroupMemberships
methods.description: Selector returning the user's group memberships.

methods.name: getMyGroupRoles
methods.description: Selector returning roles assigned to the user within groups.

methods.name: getGroupListPermissions
methods.description: Selector returning permissions for mentionable groups.

methods.name: getMyTeamRoles
methods.description: Selector returning roles assigned to the user within teams.

methods.name: getMyChannelRoles
methods.description: Function returning roles assigned to the user within channels.

methods.name: getRolesById
methods.description: Selector returning roles indexed by role ID.

methods.name: getMyPermissionsByTeam
methods.description: Selector returning permissions grouped by team.

methods.name: getMyPermissionsByGroup
methods.description: Selector returning permissions grouped by group.

methods.name: getMyPermissionsByChannel
methods.description: Selector returning permissions grouped by channel.

methods.name: haveITeamPermission
methods.description: Function to check if the user has a specific permission in a team.

methods.name: haveIGroupPermission
methods.description: Selector to check if the user has a specific permission in a group.

methods.name: haveIChannelPermission
methods.description: Function to check if the user has a specific permission in a channel.

methods.name: haveICurrentTeamPermission
methods.description: Function to check current team permission.

methods.name: haveICurrentChannelPermission
methods.description: Function to check current channel permission.
